integrity: The infinite classification is proved via an explicit minimal prefix automaton and the cited graph criterion. Finite computation corroborates but does not certify unbounded quantification. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is for standard unpadded base-q representations, occurrence count reduced modulo the same base, and prefix-distance opacity only; other moduli or metrics are unclassified. Existing separate examples and general opacity criterion are credited.
title: Opacity phase transition and minimal automata for digit-block counting sequences
